name: AI Model Development
description: Training and fine-tuning foundation models and LLMs — the compute- and capital-intensive core of modern AI. Dominated by a few frontier labs; billion-dollar-scale training runs.

name: AI Infrastructure
description: The GPU/TPU clusters, interconnects, and data pipelines that make model training possible. Includes cloud AI compute, HPC fabrics, and vector databases; the 'picks and shovels' layer.

name: Applied AI Solutions
description: Vertical AI products: medical imaging AI, fraud detection, autonomous driving, customer-service agents, code assistants. Where AI meets specific industries and revenue.

name: Edge & On-Device AI
description: Inference on phones, cameras, vehicles, and industrial sensors rather than cloud. Driven by NPU chips, privacy, and latency; fast-growing.

name: AI Safety & Alignment
description: Evaluating and aligning frontier models: red-teaming, interpretability, governance, and safety tooling. A small but strategically critical segment.

name: Generative AI & Synthetic Media
description: Text, image, video, audio, and code generation products. Consumer and enterprise; the most visible AI market (ChatGPT-class tools).

name: Wealth Management
description: Advising and managing assets for high-net-worth individuals and families: discretionary portfolios, estate planning, and private banking. Fee-based, relationship-driven.

name: Private Equity
description: Buyout and growth investing in private companies: leveraged buyouts, restructuring, and operational value creation. Large pools of committed capital.

name: Venture Capital
description: Early-stage equity investment in startups, concentrated in tech and life sciences. High risk, outsized-return model; fuels innovation ecosystems.

name: Mortgage Lending
description: Originating and servicing home loans, plus securitization into mortgage-backed securities. Cornerstone of consumer credit and housing markets.

name: Consumer Finance
description: Credit cards, personal loans, auto finance, and buy-now-pay-later. Point-of-sale and digital lending; high-volume, data-driven underwriting.

name: Custody & Asset Servicing
description: Safekeeping securities, settlement, fund administration, and reporting for institutions. Low-margin, scale-driven infrastructure of the capital markets.

name: Securities Exchanges
description: Venues for listing and trading equities, derivatives, and commodities. Includes electronic matching, market data, and listing services.

name: Clearing & Settlement
description: Post-trade infrastructure: central counterparties, netting, and securities settlement that eliminate counterparty risk.

name: Sovereign Wealth & Public Funds
description: State-owned investment funds managing national savings, commodities revenue, and pension reserves. Major long-horizon allocators.

name: Land Systems
description: Tanks, armored vehicles, artillery, and small arms. Includes munitions and soldier systems.

name: Naval Systems
description: Warships, submarines, and naval propulsion. Shipyard-intensive, decades-long programs.

name: Missiles & Missile Defense
description: Ballistic, cruise, hypersonic missiles and their interception systems. High R&D, precision-guided.

name: Defense Services & Logistics
description: Contractor logistics, maintenance, training, and base support. Private military and security services.

name: Launch Services
description: Rockets that carry payloads to orbit: reusable launchers, small-lift, medium-lift, heavy-lift. Rapidly falling cost per kg.

name: Space Services & In-Orbit
description: In-orbit servicing, refueling, debris removal, and on-orbit manufacturing. Nascent but growing.

name: Restaurants & Catering
description: Food-service establishments from fast food to fine dining, plus catering and ghost kitchens. Labor-intensive, low-margin.

name: Travel Agencies & Tour Operators
description: Packaging and selling travel: agents, online travel agencies, and tour operators.

name: Events, Meetings & Conventions
description: MICE: meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions. Tied to business travel and convention centers.

name: Cruise Lines
description: Operating cruise ships and river cruises; floating resorts with captive hospitality spending.

name: Grocery & Supermarkets
description: Food and daily-goods retail: supermarkets, hypermarkets, and discount grocers. High volume, thin margins.

name: Department Stores
description: Multi-category large-format retail. Under pressure from e-commerce and specialty.

name: Specialty Retail
description: Category-focused chains: apparel, electronics, beauty, home improvement.

name: Luxury Goods Retail
description: High-end fashion, jewelry, watches, and accessories. Brand-driven, high-margin.

name: Online Marketplaces
description: Two-sided platforms connecting buyers and sellers, monetized via commission and advertising.
